description: Trigamma function psi'(x), the derivative of digamma, for real x

tolerance.reason: Trigamma is positive and has no zeros. For x > 0 the recurrence and the asymptotic series add terms of one sign. For x < 0 the reflection formula pi^2 / sin^2(pi x) - psi'(1 - x) subtracts at most psi'(1) = pi^2 / 6 from at least pi^2, so rounding is amplified at most 1.4 times, provided sin(pi x) is formed from the exact input (as sinpi does). 1e-13 is the tolerance of the other well-conditioned functions

grid: the digamma grid without the points next to its zero and without x = -999999999999999.5, where SciPy's polygamma(1, x) does not return (it sums one term per unit step from x up)
